# loopky — plugin branch

**Generated. Do not edit or open pull requests against this branch.**

This branch holds only the Loopky agent plugin (`plugins/loopky/`), copied from
[`main`](https://github.com/jvsena42/loopky/tree/main/plugins/loopky) at each release, so plugin
directories can download it: the full repository's archive (native libraries included) is over
their size limits. The source, tests and evals live on `main`.

Install from the main repository instead: `/plugin marketplace add jvsena42/loopky`.
